title: test: cover native-to-adapted and adapted-to-native Responses fallback
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Added full-worker tests for Responses fallback in both directions: Azure's native Responses route for meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct falling back to DeepInfra's Chat-adapted route, and Bedrock's Chat-adapted route for anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 falling back to OpenRouter's native Responses route. The tests verify the completed response and fallback headers, one upstream request per route in the correct wire format, separate failed and billed Tinybird events, and a balance deduction equal to the serving fallback's charge. The upstream mocks now support a failure status that resets after each test. No production code changed.
